outer_fields.name: Utility Folder Versions
outer_fields.description: Monitors the versions of the files in the Utility Folder

fields.description: This script will query a defined folder and subfolders for EXE files and extract their full path and version numbers.
fields.settings: {"path":"$Executables = Get-ChildItem -Path C:\\UTILS -Filter *.exe -Recurse -File\n$Executables | Sort-Object -Property Name | Select-Object -Property Name, FullName, @{ Name = \"ProductVersion\"; Expression = { $_.VersionInfo.ProductVersion } }, @{ Name = \"FileVersion\"; Expression = { $_.VersionInfo.FileVersion } }","pollingfrequency":"0.0:30:0.0","pollingtimeout":"0.0:3:0.0"}

decoded_settings.path:
$Executables = Get-ChildItem -Path C:\UTILS -Filter *.exe -Recurse -File
$Executables | Sort-Object -Property Name | Select-Object -Property Name, FullName, @{ Name = "ProductVersion"; Expression = { $_.VersionInfo.ProductVersion } }, @{ Name = "FileVersion"; Expression = { $_.VersionInfo.FileVersion } }

fields.description:
Checks for all JAR files which have a reference to the 'JndiLookup.class' which is known to be affected by the CVE

Note: Servers with extremely large drives (number of files) may require additional time for the polling timeout.
